problem: Taiwan multi-channel e-commerce month-close and reconciliation
user: Taiwan e-commerce operator, finance staff or accounting handoff owner
economic_buyer: Brand owner, finance lead or operations lead

evidence_items.target_user_or_buyer: Taiwan company using website and multiple e-commerce channels
evidence_items.claim_supported: Buyer requests long-term outsourcing after cancelling internal finance; scope includes invoices, sales aggregation, reconciliation, refunds/allowances, monthly reports and accountant handoff.
evidence_items.limitations: stated NT$6,000 budget and proposal count are not payment/commitment proof

evidence_items.claim_supported: Paid roles include platform/bank reconciliation, invoices, refunds/allowances, monthly close and accountant handoff; visible salary ranges include NT$30,000–33,000 and NT$45,000–60,000/month.
Page displays customer reviews clearly referring to completed professional accounting service and recurring external bookkeeping context.
evidence_items.limitations: comparable accounting category; not exact e-commerce reconciliation package

willingness_to_pay_evidence: buyer request with stated budget; payment unproven

recurrence_and_leverage.recurrence_trigger: monthly close, refunds/allowances and tax/accounting handoff
recurrence_and_leverage.standardizable_unit: channel intake map, exception taxonomy, evidence pack, QA and handoff file
recurrence_and_leverage.leverage_path: reusable rules/templates, standardized intake, trained QA operators and selective automation

contradictory_evidence: regulated/established accounting providers may already cover it
